title: Infant formula, Gerber Good Start Gentle, Stage 1, powder, made with baby water

content.title: About
content.content: Gerber Good Start Gentle Stage 1 infant formula is a ready‑to‑use powdered milk designed for newborns and infants from birth to 6 months. The formula features partially hydrolyzed protein, prebiotic GOS, DHA, and specially purified baby water (352) that meets infant water standards.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Good Start Gentle Stage 1 is suitable for babies with increased sensitivity to cow‑milk proteins.
It contains the prebiotic GOS, which supports the growth of beneficial gut bacteria.
The formula is enriched with DHA, an omega‑3 fatty acid important for brain and eye development.
It has undergone clinical testing to confirm safety and efficacy.
Each container holds 400 g of powder, roughly enough for a 30‑day feeding period.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: The GOS prebiotic promotes beneficial bacteria, helping regular stools and reducing constipation risk.

items.title: Brain development
items.content: DHA supports neuronal growth and visual function in early life.

items.title: Easy protein absorption
items.content: Partially hydrolyzed protein reduces the digestive load for infants.

items.title: Lower allergy risk
items.content: Hydrolyzed protein and the absence of lactose lower the chance of food‑allergy development.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Vitamins A, C, E and zinc help strengthen the infant’s immune system.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Despite hydrolysis, some infants may still react to cow‑milk proteins.

items.title: Improper reconstitution
items.content: Over‑concentrated formula can cause dehydration, while overly dilute mixes may lack essential nutrients.

items.title: Storage after opening
items.content: Powder can absorb moisture, leading to clumping and quality loss.

content.title: How to Prepare
content.content: Mix the powder with clean baby water (352) according to the label, typically 1 scoop per 30 ml of water. Stir until smooth and check that the temperature does not exceed 37 °C before feeding.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the container tightly sealed in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Use within 30 days after opening. Discard if the product develops an off‑smell, color change, or unusual taste.
